snippets.MYST_CALL_BOOKWORM_CALL_01: Why good day, little Panda! What brings you to me?
snippets.MYST_CALL_BOOKWORM_CALL_02: You're searching for a magnifying glass? Of course! Every professor has a magnifying glass collection! I'll let you borrow one of my most exclusive models.
snippets.MYST_CALL_CARUSO_CALL_01: What are you doing here?! What do you want from me?!
snippets.MYST_CALL_CARUSO_CALL_02: What do you mean you know what I'm up to?
snippets.MYST_CALL_CARUSO_CALL_03: I...I...I can explain! This is how it was: the other day I was at the Pirate Bar playing with Beardy the parrot. Pandabeard was fast asleep on the counter.
snippets.MYST_CALL_CARUSO_CALL_04: I let Beardy out of the cage and wanted to see how handsome I would look with him on my shoulder, but then a gust of wind made the door fly open and Beardy flew away!
snippets.MYST_CALL_CARUSO_CALL_05: I knew that if Pandabeard found out he would be pretty mad at me, and let's just say he's not a guy you want to have on your bad side! I followed Beardy to the Mysterious Forest, where he was sitting on a branch. I kept calling him, but he wouldn't come down!
snippets.MYST_CALL_CARUSO_CALL_06: Then I remembered that Beardy's favorite food was chocolate cookies. The only thing was, was that I had no idea how to bake them! I couldn't ask you myself, Kamaria, because I know you're still mad at me for using all of your newt tails as fishing bait.
snippets.MYST_CALL_CARUSO_CALL_07: So I thought up the plan with the phone call. I disguised my voice and called up the salon.
snippets.MYST_CALL_CARUSO_CALL_08: That's the truth. I never would have hurt anyone! And I got Beardy back safe to Pandabeard!
snippets.MYST_CALL_CARUSO_CALL_09: This is a bit embarrassing for me. I didn't think I had left any traces! As an apology, here's a detective outfit. You've earned it, after all! Non-Gold Pandas will be able to wear it for five days.
snippets.MYST_CALL_CARUSO_CALL_10: I promise never to do such a thing again. Please don't be mad at me. I'll make it up to you...somehow.
snippets.MYST_CALL_KAMARIA_CALL_01: What? A mysterious voice on the telephone? You'll be in danger unless you fill a briefcase with chocolate cookies and drop it off at the pony yards? How suspenseful!
snippets.MYST_CALL_KAMARIA_CALL_02: I don't want you in any danger. Of course I will make those chocolate cookies. Unfortunately I don't have all of the ingredients. I've just run out of flour. Do you think Bruno might have some I could have?
snippets.MYST_CALL_KAMARIA_CALL_03: Where is my flour? Didn't you find any at Chez Bruno?
snippets.MYST_CALL_KAMARIA_CALL_04: Good, now we have flour. Whoops! I just used my last spoon of sugar to sweeten my tea. I can't have bitter tea! It does a number on my digestion if I just drink it plain. I'm sure you can find sugar wherever there's ice cream.
snippets.MYST_CALL_KAMARIA_CALL_05: No sugar? Did you even look? If these cookies turn out bitter, I won't be to blame! You'd better find me some, for your own sake.
snippets.MYST_CALL_KAMARIA_CALL_06: Superb, now I have everything. I'll whip these cookies up in a jiffy. Come right back and I'll be done.
snippets.MYST_CALL_KAMARIA_CALL_07: Ta da: Kamaria's Chocolate Ransom Cookies! I've already packed them up in the briefcase, but first I must tell you something very important...
snippets.MYST_CALL_KAMARIA_CALL_08: I disapprove of the fact that innocent Pandas could be in danger simply for answering a phone call. We have to get to the bottom of this. More Pandas could be in danger and besides, how will I have time to make potions when I'm making cookies all day?
snippets.MYST_CALL_KAMARIA_CALL_09: I've thought up a plan: Leave the briefcase at the pony yard just like you arranged and then go away so that the cookie ransomer sees you leaving. Immediately afterwards, go straight back and look for clues. Then come back and report to me. I would go with you, but you know how I dislike the smell of farm animals.
snippets.MYST_CALL_KAMARIA_CALL_10: You think you can handle this? Here's the briefcase. But do be careful!
snippets.MYST_CALL_KAMARIA_CALL_11: You need a magnifying glass? I'm sure Professor Bookworm has one. All professors have magnifying glasses! Go ask him if you can borrow one.
snippets.MYST_CALL_KAMARIA_CALL_12: Fantastic! Now you'll be able to really examine any clues. Go back to the pony yard and look again at the crumbs through the glass. Then come back to me.
snippets.MYST_CALL_KAMARIA_CALL_13: Where are the cookie crumbs? You didn't eat them, did you? In that case, go back and look to see if you can find any more clues.
snippets.MYST_CALL_KAMARIA_CALL_14: Ah ha! A piece of cloth. It's somehow familiar to me. Maybe this mysterious Panda will leave even more clues. Why don't you try looking for more clues tomorrow. We'll solve this mystery yet!
snippets.MYST_CALL_KAMARIA_CALL_15: Go back and look tomorrow for more clues.
snippets.MYST_CALL_KAMARIA_CALL_16: Were you able to sleep last night? Have you found more clues? Be on the look-out for more cookie crumbs!
snippets.MYST_CALL_KAMARIA_CALL_17: I see, a brownish-red lock of hair? There aren't many Pandas around here with such a hair color. I haven't any idea who it could be. Perhaps you should come back tomorrow to look for more clues.
snippets.MYST_CALL_KAMARIA_CALL_18: A carrot? Who would carry around carrots? Wait, I have an idea, but I don't want to be too hasty. Come back tomorrow to look for more clues.
snippets.MYST_CALL_KAMARIA_CALL_19: A piece of paper! These are plans on how to make an igloo! It can only be one Panda - do you know who it is?
snippets.MYST_CALL_KAMARIA_CALL_20: Let's think of the clues we've found: a brown piece of cloth, a lock of reddish-brown hair, a carrot, and an igloo draft. It has to be...it can only be...type the name of the Panda in the chat box when you think you know who it is.
snippets.MYST_CALL_KAMARIA_CALL_21: Excellent detective-skills! I'll be sure to contact you next time I misplace my crystal ball!
snippets.MYST_CALL_KAMARIA_CALL_22: But what are we supposed to do now? I bet that Carl is in the library. He's been spending a lot of time there recently. We need to confront him about this. You go on ahead while I get my slippers on.
snippets.MYST_CALL_POPUP_CALL_01: To see the clue you'll need a magnifying glass.

snippets.MYST_CALL_VOICE_CALL_01: Ha! I knew you'd answer! Well, you asked for it...
snippets.MYST_CALL_VOICE_CALL_02: You are now in great danger, curious Panda! But I will give you the opportunity to save yourself. If you follow my instructions exactly, no one will be hurt.
snippets.MYST_CALL_VOICE_CALL_03: Now listen up! I'm only gonna say it once! You see this black case by the counter? You're gonna need it.
snippets.MYST_CALL_VOICE_CALL_04: Take the case and fill it to the brim with freshly-baked chocolate cookies. You don't know how to bake? I've heard that Kamaria makes the finest cookies in the land. She's in the castle tower in her castle right now. Go tell her to help you...or else.
snippets.MYST_CALL_VOICE_CALL_05: Once you've filled the case, you're ready for the handover. But play your cards right and don't let anyone know what you're up to! And don't let anyone follow you!
snippets.MYST_CALL_VOICE_CALL_06: Take the cookie-filled case to the pony yard and place it next to the sign. Leave immediately after the drop-off unless you're looking for trouble!
snippets.MYST_CALL_VOICE_CALL_07: It's time for you to start baking, little Panda. Good luck...
snippets.MYST_CALL_VOICE_CALL_08: Take the black case and fill it with freshly-baked chocolate cookies. Go to Kamaria and ask her for help. I saw her earlier in the castle tower. Place the case full of cookies at the pony yard and nothing bad will happen!
snippets.POPUP_CALL_02: For your own safety, leave the pony yard now!
